shopWidget.request: Build an embeddable shop widget with a working preview and installation code. Deliver a web component with isolated styles, its JavaScript and any CSS, and a script plus custom-element snippet. Add backend APIs only if the feature needs them. Understand the requested feature first; ask about store data only when needed. Clearly distinguish local preview from publication and do not invent a deployed URL.
